origin: Root approved bounded contract, frozen before runtime; desired delivery remains pending implementation/independent gates.

scope.predicate: One complete minutes bound (existing scalar min/max threshold representation), explicit team/latest original named matchup/scalar regular season. Static date/venue scope precedes latest selection.
scope.original_selection: Use existing full canonical team selector with no participation/stat filters before latest1; preserve game/team/opponent/date/season.
scope.qualification: Protected existing filter_played qualifies same-game membership/side/date/state and contradictions. Known name or historical appearance alone is insufficient.
scope.exact_minutes: Require qualified same-game official report time for played athletes; source_minutes carries MM:SS precision after existing source import. Do not use rounded canonical minutes to decide exact time thresholds, overwrite them, or claim equal precision.
scope.dnp: PLAYED plus bound is conjunctive: explicit did_not_play answers No because did not play, including upper bounds. Never fabricate zero minutes, a DNP player-game row, or an older appearance stat line.
scope.unavailable: Missing/unknown/conflicting membership/state or missing qualified precise report time returns filter_not_supported with evidence note; no Boolean, no rows, no accepted minutes check. No original game retains no_match; missing underlying file retains no_data.

route_and_consumers.target_identity: metadata.player and identity-only player_context retain canonical checked athlete; team row team IDs/statistics remain team evidence, not target-player statistics.
route_and_consumers.team_identity: Explicit canonical requested team/opponent retained; no player career/current-team inference.
route_and_consumers.success_answer: Existing answer_phrase explicitly names checked athlete, Yes/No, exact MM:SS when played or explicit did-not-play, and original team/opponent/date.
success_labels: Sample selection: latest original team matchup before checking player minutes
Minutes check: canonical checked athlete plus actual normalized min/max minutes predicate

route_and_consumers.no_false_cohort: Played/minutes predicates are CHECKS on the retained game, not with_player/minutes cohort filters that removed it.
route_and_consumers.generic_stat_metadata: Clear inherited player-stat hero stat/min/max/threshold metadata as with529; retain executable internal check in existing note/answer/explicit applied check label. Never show240 team minutes as player minutes.
route_and_consumers.schema: No new public request field/result type. Reuse existing last_n/window, threshold spans/checks, internal yes_no note and result consumer fields.
